Owensboro/Daviess officials and Greater Owensboro EDC said in May 2026 there was no verified or active local project or recruitment effort; record retained as no_projects_found with policy/moratorium context.

Edmonson County Fiscal Court adopted Ordinance EC26-18 in June 2026, halting acceptance/review/approval of permits, licenses, rezoning requests, and applications for data centers, AI facilities, cryptocurrency mining, and high-intensity computing while it studies impacts. No named developer or project found.

status_detail: TeraWulf announced May 26, 2026 acquisition of a hyperscale HPC/data center site in EastPark Industrial Park with more than 1 GW expected over time; initial 500 MW expected to ramp in H2 2028 and another 500 MW targeted for H2 2030. Physical site is reported as EastPark near Ashland/Grayson and likely Boyd/Greenup area; included for Elliott because EastPark/Northeast Kentucky regional authority represents Boyd, Carter, Elliott, Greenup and Lawrence and WEKU reported tax benefits to all five counties.
notes: Geographic caveat: I did not verify that any buildings are physically inside Elliott County; Elliott is a member county of the EastPark/Northeast Kentucky regional industrial/economic development authority and is reported to share property-tax benefits. Kept in Elliott batch under 'wide net' policy.

status_detail: QX.net markets an operating colocation/data facility in Vine Center Tower in downtown Lexington. Third-party facility directories report 333 W Vine St and approximately 2.1 MW; official QX.net page confirms data facility/colocation but does not disclose MW.
